skins.name: Street Graff Moonbot
skins.description: Glossy white Moonpet styled as a cute graffiti streetwear bot with controlled neon paint marks, sticker-like accents, and clean collectible-game readability.

notes: The initial AutoSprite phase intentionally creates 3 reusable Moonpet characters only.
Request only AutoSprite-supported animations for now: idle, walk, run, attack.
Map game-only actions such as eat, play, sleep, clean, and train later after the spritesheet test is approved.
Do not generate broad trait combinations until a human approves the test batch.
Never commit real API keys or generated secrets.
